intervals.notes: D-1 on the right after joining the two-lane road (seen from 56 s). No D-2 seen; the car leaves this road by turning left onto the S1 slip road at ~65 s, so the interval ends there for this car. alt reading: the priority itself continues on the road the car left.

D-7 (blue, white car) on the right of the slip road at ~66-67 s with a plate underneath (diagram, unread). No D-8 seen for the rest of the ride; the car stays on S1 until the end of the recording (exits/slip roads at ~114-128 MOP, ~368 merge, ~414 diverge are not taken).

Blue rectangle with white up arrow (D-3) on both sides, together with B-34 end-of-60, right after the contraflow ends and the car is back on its own carriageway. On a dual-carriageway expressway this is informative; 'next intersection' is ambiguous: best end = on-ramp merge from the right ~368 s; alt = interchange diverge ~414 s or ride end.
